newRoots.actualSourceAdaptationDecision: Preserveじょうず,な/に/activityが and non-liking distinction. Relevant Wiktionary section actually supports conventionalず, not a productive reading of all手 compounds.
Wholeへた; do not deriveた from prefixた-. Preserve verb+のが下手, negative tact/苦手 distinction and noきらくない-style false inflection.
Explainな-adjective and Xが好き naturally in Russian; not好きする or a mechanical が=Russian case rule; liking a person need not be romantic.
Keep source kango technical convention for mixed on-first compounds. Explain大ダイ + native好き; strong liking, not objectively very likeable.
な-adjective despite finalい,嫌いではない; noきらくない. Negated dislike need not enthusiastic love.
いや/イヤ; reluctance and unpleasantness. Emotionalいや! is not neutral politeいいえ; temporary/stable distinctions are tendencies.
Keep full enjoyment versus楽らく/面白い/嬉しい distinctions and inflections. No invented numeric dictionary entry ID.
Preserve amusing/interesting/enjoyable, inflection and nonliteral components; no invented white-face etymology. Qualified usually-negative favourable sense must not become an unrestricted good gloss.
Keep recorded spellings and all boring/trivial/pointless and gift-modesty uses; no derivation of the taught sense as not blocked.
Keep thingが,欲しくない, sourceほ.しい,要る contrast, allたい examples and妹/欲しがる. Do not turn first-person pedagogy into a universal third-person ban.
Intransitive experiencer;財布を belongsなくす. Preserve困ります/困って,コン in困難 and困らせる perspective; practical difficulty need not anger/shame.
Keep difficult/serious/sympathy and adverb大変おいしいです with noな; extent/great is not automatically admirable quality.
Preserve importance/cherishedness and大切にする with objectを; not literal big-cutting or automatic high monetary price.
Preserve smallっ, appearance/conduct examples and omitted-subject neutrality; not literal standing-school or wealth/rank as a requirement.
Preserve Xで有名 and popularity/knownness contrast,無名 ambiguity and useful name association without invented history. No invented numeric dictionary entry ID.

Keep all polite offer/adequacy/refusal/adverb uses and context dependence. Dictionary noun structure is an evidenced additional sense motivating direct組織 guard, not the normal offer-response interpretation.
Retain ENTIRE substantialチョロい subsection, all same-question examples and優しい/容易な contrasts; slang can belittle, not a fixed extra-easy degree or automatically an insult.
Keepい-adjective inflection,で source of busyness and多忙な contrast; noな or invented single-job restriction.
Noun free time andな-adjective unoccupied; preserve fixed-expression caution,休み distinction and tact.自由 overlap is Russian label ambiguity, not leisure=liberty.
Keep便利な/に,買い物に and no便利のアプリ; usefulness is not always convenience.
Preserve kana preference and both recorded spellings withkanji:[]; noisy/annoying/fussy,食べ物に and harshうるさい!; not just decibels.
Preserve positive/neutral liveliness and noise contrast. Japanese workload/liveliness distinction must be understandable without English busy;にぎ+やか not freely removable suffix.
